Excellent related administrative/clerical experience with knowledge of standard office procedures and equipment.
Experience in higher education, student affairs, or residential life.
Experience working in a fast-paced customer-service focused environment with an emphasis on effectiveness, professionalism, tact, and integrity.
Experience in basic website maintenance and content updates.
Experience handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

Under the general supervision of the Associate Director for Colleges, the Operations Coordinator is responsible for the frontline operations of the college mailrooms, ensuring efficient and effective mail distribution while providing high-quality customer service to students, faculty, and staff. This position oversees student workers, ensures compliance with postal and university policies, and manages mailroom logistics. Additionally, the Operations Coordinator provides administrative, clerical, and customer service support to the College Office and CSL staff, assisting with general office operations, facilities coordination, and customer service.

The Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation of the university mailrooms while also supporting general office functions and administrative responsibilities within the college community.
Familiarity with student supervision in a university setting.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.
Work is primarily on-site in a mailroom and office environment with regular interaction with students, staff, and faculty. Requires standing and walking between campus locations.
May require occasional evening or weekend work during peak mailroom operations (e.g., move-in/move-out periods).
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.
